images.caption:
Map of battlefield core and study areas.
The Study Area was expanded to show the Federal pursuit of the Army of Tennessee from Chattanooga. It also includes the route taken by the Confederate wagon train southwest toward Dalton.

Cleburne’s stand at Ringgold Gap insured that the vital wagons remained in Confederate control.
